definitions.explanation: Income or profit generated from business activities or investments.

{収益|しゅうえき} is a formal business term for earnings or profit.

- {収益|しゅうえき}⟦{力|りょく}→力：noentry⟧: Earning power
- {収益|しゅうえき}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: Profit margin, rate of return
- {収益|しゅうえき}⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧: Revenue structure
- {収益|しゅうえき}⟦{源|げん}→源：noentry⟧: Revenue source

- {収益|しゅうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to increase profits
- {収益|しゅうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}む→生む：29531_umu⟧: to generate profits
